source_scope: Text-box and callout fill, border-width properties, saved tool defaults, FreeText /C appearance regeneration, and automation comment_edit support.
varve_assessment: Relevant usability gap remains for ordinary TextNode frame background and border. Callout body already uses a standard fillable/strokable ShapeNode; this is not equivalent to a text-box frame control. A Varve implementation must cover scene persistence, editor controls, canvas/native/WASM rendering, PDF export and save/reopen.
evidence: Issue body and comments; merged PR summary, file/change summary, review comment, and merge event inspected. The source PR reports annot, automation, UI, and native-app checks; these are source-project evidence only.

source_scope: Text-box and callout fill plus border-width controls, including zero-width border handling, saved defaults and persistent annotation appearance.
varve_assessment: Relevant partial workflow gap remains for a generic TextNode frame fill/border; TextNode.strokes currently describe glyph strokes, while callout bodies use a separate stroked shape. A Varve implementation must keep these semantics distinct and verify editing, export, and persistence.
evidence: Issue body and comments; merged PR summary, file/change summary, review comment, and merge event inspected. The source PR reports annotation, automation, UI, and native-app checks; these are source-project evidence only.

varve_change: Optional TextNode.textFrame background and border; schema 2.34; Inspector controls; Canvas2D and shadow-source replay; Rust bridge/render IR/PDF export.
acceptance: Preserve unstyled legacy documents and glyph fills/strokes; support no-fill and zero-width; save/reopen; validate point, area, rich, vertical, clipped and reflowed text; inspect Canvas2D and native PDF renders; run native/WASM and planned full gate.
research: Inkscape Text/Border padding #3705 documents a background/border/inset request and a multi-object workaround; this implementation does not add padding. The separate Reddit outside-glyph-stroke report is not represented as resolved by a frame border.
validation: App visual E2E passes (save/reopen, enabled fill and zero-width persistence) with inspected desktop and 1024x768 captures; website E2E passes (2/2) with inspected desktop and 390x844 screenshots. Targeted Rust tests and changed-crate Clippy, WASM crate/build, SVG suite (12/12), and independent Poppler PDF rendering/text extraction pass. Website/Astro and website-E2E typechecks plus 126-route website builds pass. Initial affected triage stopped at contention-sensitive editor/engine tests; all four observed tests passed in isolated reruns. Complete affected triage and exact-SHA full gate remain pending.
marketing: Typography page labels the behavior In development and says it is not in a released build; no availability claim is made.
